message.content:
Based on my search, I can provide you with information about **CFA Institute membership fees and requirements**. Since your query "cfa ins" was brief, I'll cover the key aspects of CFA Institute membership.

## CFA Institute Membership Overview

### Types of Membership

| Membership Type | Requirements | Purpose |
|----------------|------------|---------|
| **Regular Membership** | Pass Level I CFA Exam + 4,000 hours of relevant work experience over 36 months + professional references | Required to earn the CFA charter; includes voting rights |
| **Affiliate Membership** | Pass Level I CFA Exam | For those who don't meet regular membership requirements; no work experience needed |

### Membership Fees (2026)

| Fee Component | Amount |
|-------------|--------|
| **CFA Institute Annual Dues (Regular Member)** | **USD $299/year** |
| **Local Society Dues** | Varies by region (USD $50–$200/year) |
| **Professional Leave Rate** | Reduced rate available for eligible members |

### Key Changes for 2026

- **Enrollment fee abolished**: The one-time USD $350 enrollment fee was eliminated starting April 2025 (for February 2026 exams onward)
- **CFA Society India** now collects dues in **local currency (INR)**

### Requirements to Become a CFA Charterholder

1. **Pass all three CFA exam levels** (Level 1, 2, and 3)
2. **Accumulate 4,000 hours** of qualified work experience over at least **36 months**
3. **Provide 2-3 professional references** (2 if one is an active regular member of your local CFA society; 3 otherwise)
4. **Sign the Ethics Pledge**
5. **Apply for CFA Institute membership** (including joining a local CFA society)

### Important Notes

- You can only use the "CFA" designation if you maintain **active Regular Membership**
- If membership lapses, you lose the right to use the CFA designation, but can reactivate by paying back dues
- Work experience can be accumulated **before, during, or after** passing the exams
- Membership applications typically take up to **10 business days** for CFA Institute review, plus up to **1 month** for local society review

---

Sources:
1. https://300hours.com/cfa-exam-cost/
2. https://capstonelearnings.com/cfa-vs-frm-india/
3. https://www.zelleducation.com/blog/cfa-membership-fees/
4. https://cfasocietyindia.org/membership/
5. https://quintedge.com/blog/cfa-course-fee
6. https://300hours.com/cfa-requirements/
7. https://rbeiset.com/cfa-course-2026-eligibility-fees-syllabus-career-scope/
8. https://proschoolonline.com/blog/cfa-enrollment-fees-update
